topic: Should we build this feature in-house or buy an existing SaaS solution?
description: Decide whether to develop a feature internally or purchase a third-party SaaS solution, considering cost, time-to-market, customization, and maintenance.
investigationInstructions: Define feature requirements: must-have vs. nice-to-have capabilities.
Estimate build cost: engineering time, infrastructure, ongoing maintenance.
Estimate buy cost: subscription fees, implementation, integration.
Assess customization needs vs. SaaS flexibility.
Evaluate strategic value: is this a core differentiator or commodity feature?
Consider vendor lock-in and exit strategy for the buy option.
Assess opportunity cost of engineering time diverted from core product.
evidenceRequirements: SaaS vendor options with pricing and features
Historical build vs. buy outcomes for similar features
Maintenance cost estimates for self-built solutions
expectedOutputStructure: Executive summary with recommendation (build vs. buy)
Cost comparison: build (engineering + maintenance) vs. buy (subscription + integration)
Feature coverage analysis (requirements met by each option)
Risk assessment (vendor lock-in, maintenance burden, timeline risk)
Implementation plan for the chosen approach
